faq.q: How long until the carpet's dry?
faq.a: Usually 4 to 6 hours. Good airflow and a running fan speed it up. You can walk on it sooner in clean socks.
I move the light stuff (couches, chairs, tables) and put it all back. I leave heavy pieces like beds and dressers in place and clean around them.

faq.q: Can you get old stains out?
faq.a: Most of the time, yes. Some set-in stains won't come all the way out, but I'll tell you straight what I think before I start.

faq.q: How often should I have it done?
faq.a: Once a year for most homes. Every 6 months if you've got pets, kids, or allergies.
